title: Water Works & Denton I.S.D. Natatorium
specs: Multiple thrilling water slides with height and weight restrictions
Lazy River with ADA accessibility and water access chair
Wave Pool with gradual beach entry and waves up to 5 feet
Children's interactive splash zone with mini slides and water features
Private cabanas with privacy screens, loungers, and tables
Guests under 48 inches not permitted on Big Kahuna, Hula Loop, Puka slides
Guests under 42 inches not permitted on Ohana slide
Maximum weight 400 lbs on Big Kahuna slide, 300 lbs on Hula Loop, Puka, Ohana slides
Children 6 and younger and anyone wearing a life jacket must have an adult in the water at all times
Children 7-14 must be accompanied by an adult age 16 or older
includes: Staff included with full park rentals
Slides, kiddie pool, river, wave pool included with full park rentals
Party host included with birthday rentals
Candy Haven cake included with birthday rentals
Sweet Treat vouchers included with birthday rentals
Juice boxes and bottled waters included with Luau Lagoon birthday rental
Paper products included with Luau Lagoon birthday rental
Cooler passes included with birthday rentals
gap: Exact prices for birthday party rentals not stated
blurb: Guests enjoy multiple water slides including Ohana, Puka, Hula Loop, and Big Kahuna slides with height restrictions. The park features a lazy river, wave pool, children's play pool with mini slides, and a sand volleyball court. Private cabanas and birthday party rentals are available, along with concessions and a gift shop.
extraNote: Groups of 10+ receive $3 discount per admission if purchased in same transaction · Rain check given if full closure due to inclement weather and guest inside less than 2 hours; not valid for discounted, Dive In or Twilight admissions · Temporary closures for weather allow guests to remain inside or leave and return same day with wristband; no rain checks for temporary closures · Inclement weather causes temporary closure of slides and pools; reopening when safe · Water Works Park adjacent to Denton Natatorium and Skate Park, parking lot adjacent to Denton ISD CH Collins Athletic Complex. · May 23 through September 7, 2026
